verses.text: So first of all, I urge you to pray for everyone. Ask God for what they need, pray for them, speak to God for them, and give thanks for them.
Pray for kings and for all who are in power, so that we can live calm and quiet lives, serving God and living in a way that is respectful.
This is good, and it pleases God our Saviour.
He wants all people to be saved and to know the truth fully.
There is one God. And there is one go-between for God and people, the man Christ Jesus.
He gave himself to pay the price to set all people free. This was the message God gave at the right time.
That is why I was chosen to preach it and to be an apostle. I am telling the truth in Christ, I am not lying. I was chosen to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
So I want men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or arguing.
In the same way, I want women to dress modestly and decently, with good sense. They should not make themselves beautiful with fancy braided hair, gold, pearls or expensive clothes.
Instead, they should make themselves beautiful by doing good things. That is right for women who say they worship God.
A woman should learn quietly and fully accept what she is taught.
I do not allow a woman to teach a man or to have authority over him. She should be quiet.
For Adam was made first, and then Eve.
And Adam was not the one who was tricked. It was the woman who was tricked and fell into sin.
But women will be saved through having children, if they keep on in faith, love and holiness, with good sense.
